name: relu2
description: Fused square-ReLU activation: out = relu(input)^2, with the ReLU and multiplication performed in float32 and the result cast back to input.dtype. The input is treated as a two-dimensional [rows, dim] tensor, and the kernel uses its row/column strides for flat access. Returns a newly allocated tensor of the same shape and dtype, without mutating the input. The suites exercise two-dimensional bfloat16 inputs.
